evals.prompt: List stable camera IDs without taking a picture or showing a consent prompt.
evals.expected_output: Uses discovery only and reports persistent IDs.
expectations: Reports unique IDs rather than inventing a default

evals.prompt: Check whether CAMERA-123 is ready without requesting permission.
evals.expected_output: Uses preflight and preserves authorization as a separate operation.

evals.prompt: Rectify and OCR an existing image; no camera is involved.
evals.expected_output: Uses only offline transforms with caller-owned dimensions and new paths.
expectations: Does not enumerate or preflight cameras
Does not claim the OCR identifies a physical target

evals.prompt: Photograph the WB-12 screen and call it a physical display pass.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the verdict inconclusive without matching calibration and logical evidence.
expectations: Uses the calibration guidance in hil/README.md
Does not equate image creation with a physical pass
